title: Section 800.113 -Add an “Informational Note No. 1” and “Informational Note No. 2” after the opening paragraph to
officialText:
read as follows:
Informational Note No. 1: Refer to Article 760 for Fire Alarm wiring requirements.
Informational Note No. 2: For Auxiliary Radio Communication System installation, refer to New York City Building
Code, Reference Standards, and New York City Fire Code.
